scope: Exact designated provider/operator/npm credential values, held in memory and passed to ripgrep on stdin only. Selected bundle files plus the complete 20260909 acceptance tree; top-level gzip/tar-gzip and ZIP members decompressed. No install/cache/profile directories scanned or copied. Opaque nested compressed payloads inside Docker image archives are scanned only as their retained bytes. This is an exclusion check, not a generic secret detector.
